briefdescription.para: Performance benchmarks for auth token validation latency (Issue #1551).

detaileddescription.para:
Measures end-to-end latency for the following operations:
JWT RS256 validation with cached JWKS (happy path)
JWT validation with JTI blacklist lookup (revocation check)
JWT validation failure – expired token
JWT validation failure – wrong issuer
TokenBlacklist::isRevoked – JTI present (revoked token)
TokenBlacklist::isRevoked – JTI absent (clean token)
TOTP validateTOTP computation
AuthMiddleware static API token lookup (single token)
AuthMiddleware static API token lookup (1 000-token map)

Latency targets (from include/auth/README.md):
JWT validation (cached JWKS): < 5 ms
TOTP validation: < 10 ms
Build: cmake -DTHEMIS_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON ... && cmake build . target bench_auth_token_validation Run: ./benchmarks/bench_auth_token_validation benchmark_format=json
